name: Four Fields Furniture
description: Four Fields Furniture is a small custom woodworking shop based in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area. Since 2014, owner Adam Bischoff has been building beautiful, heirloom-quality furniture one piece at a time. Working with solid hardwoods and wood-and-steel combinations, Four Fields specializes in custom hardwood dining tables, live-edge slab dining tables, coffee tables, side tables, desks, entryway benches, and more—each one designed to fit your space and reflect your personal style.
